intent.proves: At least one active website has robots.txt content or includes the sitemap in robots.txt.

bindings.reason: Needs a projection on robots settings; mcp-count counts rows only.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Area WHERE AreaActive = 1 AND AreaDeleted = 0 AND (AreaRobotsTxtIncludeSitemap = 1 OR LEN(ISNULL(CAST(AreaRobotsTxt AS nvarchar(max)), N'')) > 0)
